We do not deny that Arab-Islamic philosophy took religious forms. Like other medieval philosophies, it was tied to religious history. But this real feature does not conceal its materialist tendencies. Medieval philosophers were able to express their materialist philosophical inclinations through religious forms—sometimes openly, as with Ibn Sina, and sometimes through symbolism or strategic maneuvering.↩︎
